requirements.requirement: The system must include an explainability field in the evaluate_care_facade response payload when scoring data is available.
The system must populate the explainability field using the schema defined in EVAL-EXPLAIN-ST-001.
The system must invoke normalization and contribution logic from EVAL-EXPLAIN-ST-002 to compute explainability values.
The system must ensure each measure in the explainability payload includes measure_id, raw_value, normalized_score, weight, and contribution_to_final_score.
The system must preserve existing response fields and structure in evaluate_care_facade while adding explainability data.
The system must ensure the addition of explainability does not break existing tool routing or response handling logic.
The system must return explainability data in a deterministic order for measures to ensure consistent downstream rendering.
The system must include explainability data only when a final score is successfully computed.
The system must omit or null the explainability field when scoring inputs are missing or incomplete.
The system must handle failures in normalization or contribution logic by returning a valid response without explainability and without crashing.
The system must log errors encountered during explainability computation for debugging without exposing internal errors to the chat layer.
The system must structure explainability output in a way that is directly consumable by the chat layer without additional transformation.
The system must ensure explainability values are numeric and within expected bounds (e.g., normalized_score between 0 and 1) before returning.
The system must ensure the sum of contribution_to_final_score values aligns with the final score within an acceptable tolerance.
The system must support LLM consumption by providing semantically clear field names and avoiding ambiguous or nested structures in explainability output.
